description: Source code defining classes and constants for x86_64 architecture-specific GDB stub handling, including register and exception vector definitions, and methods for parsing core dump data and generating GDB packets.

classes.name: RegNum
classes.description: Defines register number constants matching AMD64 register enum in GDB.

classes.name: ExceptionVectors
classes.description: Defines exception vector constants matching kernel architecture data.

classes.name: GdbStub_x86_64
classes.description: Implements GDB stub for x86_64 architecture, handling core dump parsing and signal mapping.

methods.name: parse_arch_data_block
methods.description: Parses architecture-specific core dump data to extract register states and exception info.

methods.name: compute_signal
methods.description: Maps exception vector to GDB signal number.

methods.name: handle_register_group_read_packet
methods.description: Generates a GDB packet with register values for a group read.

methods.name: handle_register_single_read_packet
methods.description: Handles a GDB 'p' packet for a single register, returning an unavailable value.
